entries.mechanism: Explicit current GA ARM64 runner; existing read-only central audit and ordinary reviewed PR on provider target change.
entries.validation: Canonical hardening policy, actual ARM64 CI, Android cache/submission, CodeQL and negative controls; no x64 fallback.

entries.mechanism: Actual minimum supported consumer smoke lane; maintenance uses current Xcode and Swift CodeQL uses GA channel.
entries.validation: Required macOS 15 packaged compatibility of Xcode-produced candidate; exact-SHA reuse requires both prior producer and consumer success.

revisit.rationale: Package.swift explicitly supports macOS 15; moving the consumer lane removes proof of the supported floor.
revisit.trigger: Provider retires runner, minimum supported macOS changes, or smoke proof becomes invalid; obtain real floor evidence or explicit product support decision.

entries.validation: Full Swift autobuild and original SARIF extraction/High-Critical verdict; protected-main four-language authority retained.

entries.mechanism: Explicit Xcode SDK image for build/release; ordinary coordinated provider review.
entries.validation: Actual build/test, packaging, minimum OS smoke and release preflight.
